verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas handles legal documents, including creating, sending and tracking SAFEs and Cooley-developed templates, so a contract-workflow question is fair to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence describes configurable approval workflows or routing contracts for approval before signature. Document templates and SAFE sending are adjacent features, not approval routing.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can route contracts through configurable approval workflows before signature
